definitions.de: Bedecken, abdecken; auch: regieren, verwalten (ein Land oder Gebiet)
definitions.en: To cover (something); also to govern or rule (a country or area)
definitions.es: Cubrir (algo); también gobernar o administrar (un país o área)
definitions.fr: Couvrir (quelque chose); aussi gouverner ou administrer (un pays ou une région)
definitions.hi: ढकना (कुछ); किसी देश या क्षेत्र पर शासन करना
definitions.ja: 覆う、かぶせる；また統治する、治める（国や地域を）
definitions.km: គ្របដណ្តប់ (អ្វីមួយ); ក៏ដឹកនាំ ឬគ្រប់គ្រង (ប្រទេស ឬតំបន់) ផងដែរ
definitions.ko: 덮다, 가리다; 또한 (나라나 지역을) 통치하다, 지배하다
definitions.ne: ढाक्नु (कुनै चीज); कुनै देश वा क्षेत्र शासन गर्नु वा नियन्त्रण गर्नु
definitions.pt: Cobrir (algo); também governar ou administrar (um país ou área)
definitions.th: ปกคลุม, คลุม; ยังหมายถึงปกครอง (ประเทศหรือพื้นที่)
definitions.tl: Takpan (ang isang bagay); pamamahala o pag-govern (ng isang bansa o lugar)
definitions.ur: ڈھانپنا (کوئی چیز)؛ کسی ملک یا علاقے پر حکومت کرنا
definitions.vi: Che phủ, đậy lên (cái gì đó); cũng có nghĩa là cai trị, quản lý (một quốc gia hoặc vùng đất)
definitions.zh: 覆盖（某物）；也指统治、管辖（一个国家或地区）
definitions.zh_Hant: 覆蓋（某物）；也指統治、管轄（一個國家或地區）

definition_en: To cover (something); also to govern or rule (a country or area)

lao_examples.lao_script: ເອົາຜ້າປົກເຂົ້າໄວ້ ບໍ່ໃຫ້ແມງວັນຕອມ
lao_examples.romanization: ao pha pok khao wai, bo hai maeng wan tom
lao_examples.translation_en: Cover the rice with a cloth so flies don't get on it.

lao_examples.lao_script: ລັດຖະບານປົກປະເທດຊາດຢ່າງດີ
lao_examples.romanization: lat tha ban pok pa thet sat yang di
lao_examples.translation_en: The government governs the country well.
